tip.0: Tip: You can click on enemy beasts during battle to target them with your attacks!
tip.1: Tip: Hold items can give your beasts powerful stat boosts — check the Item button on your beast's page.
tip.2: Tip: Set a contract target in Auto Contract to only catch the species you want.
tip.3: Tip: Fusing two beasts of the same species can create a stronger offspring with better genes!
tip.4: Tip: Each expedition has a unique boss pool — check the boss preview before starting.
tip.5: Tip: Arena wins earn you ranking points. Climb the leaderboard to earn exclusive titles!
tip.6: Tip: Some beasts only appear as rare bosses in high-level expeditions.
tip.7: Tip: Use the Skill Tree to unlock passive bonuses like extra XP, gold, and catch rate.
tip.8: Tip: You can share your beast or tamer card in chat — show off your progress!
tip.9: Tip: Nature Runes from the Boss Token shop let you pick your beast's nature.
tip.10: Tip: Gene Boosters increase a random IV by +3 — great for perfecting your best beasts.
tip.11: Tip: Join a guild to participate in raid battles and earn guild perks!
tip.12: Tip: Hard Mode expeditions give bonus XP and gold but enemies are 10 levels higher.
tip.13: Tip: You can change your tamer's title from the Profile panel — unlock more through achievements.
tip.14: Join our Discord for updates, feedback, and community events! discord.gg/dJTTyCqKru
tip.15: Tip: Elite Contract Ink from the Boss Token shop gives +15% catch rate for 10 minutes.
tip.16: Tip: Your beasts earn Veteran Ranks as they fight more battles, gaining bonus stats!
tip.17: Tip: Check the Beastiary to track which species you've discovered and caught.
tip.welcome: Welcome to Beastborne! Type to chat with other players.
tip.discord: Join our Discord for updates, feedback, and community events! discord.gg/dJTTyCqKru

data.monster.embrik.desc: A chubby little ember foal with stubby legs and a flickering mane. It trips over its own hooves but leaves tiny scorch marks wherever it tumbles.
data.monster.charrow.desc: A hollow creature with seven burning eyes. It was once a funeral pyre that refused to die, taking the shape of what it consumed.
data.monster.ashenmare.desc: A beast of obsidian and eternal flame, born when a volcano's heart broke. Its hooves leave glass flowers that bloom into fire.
data.monster.droskul.desc: A plump little eel with a stubby body and oversized eyes. It can barely swim straight, but the soft glow at its tail already hints at its predatory future.
data.monster.luracoil.desc: An electric eel that traded its spark for the ocean's depths. Its bioluminescent lure attracts prey with false promises of warmth in cold waters.
data.monster.tidehollow.desc: The abyss given form. It is said to be where the ocean goes to forget. Ships that enter its presence simply cease to have ever existed.
data.monster.wispryn.desc: A playful spirit born from echoes that never found their way back. It collects sounds and releases them in unexpected places.
data.monster.hollowgale.desc: A faceless wanderer that wears the skin of passing storms. Where it walks, the air forgets how to be still.
data.monster.vexstorm.desc: Not a bird but the angry pause between thunderclaps given consciousness. It exists in the moment before lightning strikes, forever.
data.monster.twigsnap.desc: A small creature made of fallen branches that mimic the sound of snapping twigs to lure curious travelers. It means no harm, just wants company.
data.monster.branchling.desc: A walking thicket that plants itself in clearings. It protects the youngest trees in the forest from being trampled.
data.monster.dewdrop.desc: A tiny water spirit that forms on leaves at dawn. It believes morning is the best part of the day and sleeps through everything else.
data.monster.dustling.desc: A fuzzy moth larva that gathers dust and starlight in its soft coat. It dreams of flight while crawling through moonlit shadows.
data.monster.flickermoth.desc: A luminous moth with a lantern heart that glows with stolen starlight. It guides lost travelers, though not always in the direction they intended.
data.monster.mosscreep.desc: A slow creature covered in ancient moss. It remembers every footstep that has passed over it and dreams of all the places it cannot go.
data.monster.whiskerwind.desc: A small fox-like spirit that rides on gentle breezes. It collects whispers and trades them for secrets.
data.monster.galefox.desc: A graceful fox that runs so fast it leaves temporary gaps in the air. Other creatures use these wind-tunnels to travel unseen.
data.monster.glimshroom.desc: A phosphorescent mushroom creature that pulses with soft light. It feeds on ambient magic and glows brighter near powerful creatures.
data.monster.cinderscale.desc: A chubby salamander with spotted scales that glow like cooling lava. Small crystalline formations sprout along its back, releasing thin wisps of smoke as it waddles about on stubby legs.
data.monster.blazefang.desc: A fire serpent with spotted scales and crystalline lava formations along its spine. Smoke rises from its back as its tail flame burns with predatory intensity.
data.monster.magmite.desc: A tiny spirit that lives in the gaps between cooling lava. It believes it can keep volcanoes from dying if it works hard enough.
data.monster.smolderpup.desc: A small canine with fur that smolders but never burns. It was born from the ashes of a faithful hound that protected its home from wildfire.
data.monster.emberhound.desc: A fierce wolf whose howl carries embers on the wind. It marks its territory with rings of controlled fire that never spread.
data.monster.infernowarg.desc: A massive wolf wreathed in eternal flame. Ancient stories say it was once a star that fell to earth and chose to run with the wolves rather than return to the sky.
data.monster.puddlejaw.desc: A small beast that forms when rain collects in forgotten places. It swallows reflections and spits them out in the wrong order.
data.monster.mirrorpond.desc: A creature that is simultaneously the surface and depth of still water. Those who gaze into it see not themselves, but who they were afraid to become.
data.monster.weepfin.desc: A fish made entirely of crystallized tears. It swims through air as easily as water, always searching for someone crying alone.
data.monster.streamling.desc: A playful spirit born from babbling brooks. It communicates in the sounds of running water and is always surprised when others can't understand.
data.monster.rivercrest.desc: A dignified water spirit that guards the junction where rivers meet. It mediates disputes between streams that cannot agree on where to flow.
data.monster.oceanmaw.desc: The place where all rivers end given consciousness. It remembers every drop of water that has ever reached the sea and mourns those that evaporated before arriving.
data.monster.bubblite.desc: A tiny jellyfish whose dome holds a pocket of air from its first breath. It drifts through the shallows, afraid to venture into deeper waters alone.
data.monster.foamwraith.desc: A ghostly jellyfish that drifts where sailors were lost at sea. It carries their final prayers in its trailing tendrils and guides ships away from the same fate.
data.monster.coralheim.desc: A living reef that detached itself from the ocean floor. It carries an entire ecosystem on its back and is always looking for a new place to anchor.
data.monster.driftmote.desc: A creature made of dust and forgotten paths. It follows travelers not to harm them, but because it has forgotten how to find its own way.
data.monster.galeclaw.desc: A beast woven from the last breaths of dying winds. Its claws are made of solidified gusts, and its cry is the sound of doors slamming in empty houses.
data.monster.whistleshade.desc: A creature that exists only in the sound of wind passing through hollow places. It can only be seen from the corner of your eye.
data.monster.zephyrmite.desc: A tiny creature that rides on the backs of breezes. It weighs less than a whisper and dreams of becoming a tempest someday.
data.monster.cyclonyx.desc: A spinning creature that has become one with the wind itself. It communicates by changing air pressure and is constantly dizzy but doesn't mind.
data.monster.tempestking.desc: The storm that other storms tell stories about. It doesn't cause destruction - destruction simply happens where it chooses to exist. It considers this a minor inconvenience.
data.monster.featherwisp.desc: A delicate bird made entirely of detached feathers. Each feather came from a different bird, and the Featherwisp remembers all their flights.
data.monster.plumestorm.desc: A majestic bird that trails a storm of feathers wherever it flies. Legends say finding one of its feathers grants a single perfect day of weather.
data.monster.vortexel.desc: A creature that is actually a small, stable tornado that gained sentience. It's perpetually confused about why other creatures don't spin.
data.monster.sparklet.desc: A living spark born when lightning struck the same place twice. It desperately seeks others of its kind but its touch destroys what it loves.
data.monster.voltweave.desc: A web of consciousness spun from storm-stolen thoughts. Each arc of electricity is a memory it has borrowed from those struck by lightning.
data.monster.temporal.desc: The pulse between heartbeats given form. It exists in the space between seconds, where time stutters and reality holds its breath.
data.monster.staticling.desc: A creature born from the frustration of electronics that don't work. It feeds on the anger of people hitting machines to make them function.
data.monster.joltpaw.desc: A small rodent whose fur stands on end permanently. It accidentally shocks everyone it tries to befriend and has learned to express affection from a distance.
data.monster.thundermane.desc: A majestic lion whose mane crackles with contained storms. It has learned to control its power and can finally touch those it loves without hurting them.
data.monster.zapfin.desc: An electric eel that left the water to explore the land. It's constantly amazed that air doesn't conduct electricity as well as water.
data.monster.boltgeist.desc: The ghost of lightning that struck but didn't hit anything. It wanders eternally, looking for something worthy of being struck.
data.monster.circuitsprite.desc: A creature that lives in the flow of electricity itself. It perceives the world as pathways and resistances, and finds organic life bafflingly inefficient.
data.monster.rootling.desc: A small creature formed from the first footprint ever pressed into soil. It remembers every step taken upon the earth.
data.monster.cragmaw.desc: A walking cavern with teeth of stalactite. It doesn't hunt - it waits, and the earth reshapes to bring prey inside.
data.monster.monoleth.desc: A mountain that remembered it could move. Civilizations have risen and fallen on its back without ever knowing they walked upon something alive.
data.monster.rubblekin.desc: A spirit that possesses fallen debris. It collects broken things and tries to rebuild them, though it never quite understands what they were supposed to be.
data.monster.pebblit.desc: A living pebble that rolls around collecting other small stones. It dreams of becoming a boulder someday but enjoys being small enough to fit in cozy places.
data.monster.boulderon.desc: A massive rolling stone that gained wisdom from its journey. It has traveled so far that it no longer remembers where it started, and that makes it sad.
data.monster.quartzite.desc: A creature made of crystal-veined stone. It hums at frequencies that make other crystals vibrate, creating music only the earth can hear.
data.monster.dustback.desc: A turtle-like creature with an entire desert ecosystem on its shell. Tiny sandstorms form in miniature dunes when it walks.
data.monster.terraclops.desc: A one-eyed creature that sees through stone as easily as air. It guards ancient treasures that it has completely forgotten the purpose of.
data.monster.frostling.desc: A shard of the first winter that ever was. It doesn't understand warmth and believes all things secretly wish to be still and frozen.
data.monster.glacimaw.desc: Formed from the crystallized last words of those who froze alone. It speaks only in the voices of the dying, promising warmth it cannot give.
data.monster.permafrost.desc: The memory of a world that died of cold, walking. It is what remains when even stars forget how to burn. Patient. Inevitable. Waiting.
data.monster.shivershard.desc: A creature made of the cold that seeps into bones. It doesn't freeze you - it simply reminds your body that warmth was never promised.
data.monster.snowmite.desc: A tiny creature that lives inside individual snowflakes. Each one is unique, and they take great pride in their patterns.
data.monster.blizzardian.desc: When enough Snowmites gather together, they form a Blizzardian - a walking snowstorm that remembers being thousands of unique individuals.
data.monster.iciclaw.desc: A predator made of living ice. It hunts by waiting motionless until prey mistakes it for a harmless ice formation.
data.monster.frostwisp.desc: The ghost of breath that froze mid-exhale. It drifts through cold places, leaving tiny ice crystals that spell out words no one can read.
data.monster.sleethorn.desc: A creature covered in razor-sharp ice horns. It's actually quite gentle but has learned to keep its distance from others for their safety.
data.monster.glacierback.desc: A massive creature that carries an actual glacier on its shell. Entire ecosystems of ice-dwelling creatures live on its back without knowing they're mobile.
data.monster.sproutkin.desc: A wandering seed that forgot where it was supposed to grow. It carries the potential of forests that will never exist, dreaming of roots it will never have.
data.monster.thornveil.desc: A mass of vines that learned to think by strangling a forgotten god. It grows not toward sunlight but toward secrets, and its thorns drink memories.
data.monster.eldergrove.desc: An entire forest compressed into a single being. Every tree that ever was or will be exists somewhere in its rings. It speaks in the language of growth and decay.
data.monster.mosswhisper.desc: A creature that grows in places where secrets were buried. It absorbs confessions whispered to empty rooms and hums them back at inappropriate times.
data.monster.pollenpuff.desc: A fluffy creature made entirely of pollen. It spreads flowers wherever it bounces, though it's terribly allergic to itself and constantly sneezes.
data.monster.bloomguard.desc: A noble flower knight that protects gardens from those who would pick without permission. It has overcome its allergy and now commands pollen armies.
data.monster.vinewhip.desc: A tempered vine that moves like a snake. It wraps around trees for comfort and gets terribly lonely when there's nothing nearby to hug.
data.monster.curublast.desc: A small jungle guardian with wild flame-red hair and feet that face backwards. It leads those who harm the forest in circles until they lose their minds, but guides the kind-hearted safely through.
data.monster.willowwisp.desc: A spirit that lives in weeping willows, collecting the tears the trees shed. It believes the trees are sad and tries to cheer them up, not understanding they're just shaped that way.
data.monster.verdantis.desc: A creature that is spring itself given form. Where it walks, flowers bloom out of season and dormant seeds spontaneously sprout.
data.monster.coglet.desc: A small spirit born from a gear that fell from something vast and unknowable. It spins endlessly, believing that if it stops, some great machine will fail.
data.monster.ironclad.desc: An amalgamation of swords that refused to draw blood. They bound themselves together in shame, becoming a creature that protects rather than destroys.
data.monster.forgeborn.desc: The first metal that was ever smelted, remembering when it was ore, remembering when it was mountain, choosing to become something new. It is the moment of transformation incarnate.
data.monster.corrode.desc: A spirit of entropy that clings to metal. It believes it is helping things return to their natural state, unaware that it is feared rather than thanked.
data.monster.oxidrake.desc: A dragon made of every rusted sword, every fallen crown, every abandoned machine. It is the graveyard of human ambition given wings.
data.monster.scrapper.desc: A small creature assembled from discarded scrap metal. It adds pieces to itself constantly, dreaming of becoming a mighty machine.
data.monster.junktitan.desc: A massive construct assembled from an entire junkyard's worth of metal. It finally achieved its dream of becoming mighty, but now worries about being dismantled for parts.
data.monster.bladefly.desc: An insect with wings of sharpened steel. It doesn't mean to cut things - it just can't help that it's made of razors.
data.monster.bellguard.desc: A creature that formed inside an old church bell. It rings itself to warn of danger and is confused when people run away from the warning instead of toward it.
data.monster.chainlink.desc: A creature made of interlocking metal links. It can stretch itself incredibly thin or ball up into an impenetrable sphere. It's not sure which form is the 'real' one.
data.monster.chromedragon.desc: A dragon whose scales are polished to a perfect mirror shine. It's incredibly vain and spends hours admiring its own reflection.
data.monster.dawnmote.desc: A fragment of the first sunrise that refused to fade. It brings warmth to cold hearts but cannot understand why shadows exist.
data.monster.haloveil.desc: When a Dawnmote gathers enough light, it condenses into a veiled spirit crowned by a golden halo. It drifts silently through the world, leaving trails of warmth in its wake.
data.monster.solmara.desc: A radiant bird born from gathered dawn-light, crowned by rings of every color sunrise has ever worn. Its prismatic feathers shimmer with hues that have no names.
data.monster.echomind.desc: A being formed from thoughts that outlived their thinkers. It knows things that no living person remembers and asks questions that have no answers.
data.monster.wishling.desc: A small spirit born from wishes thrown into fountains. It wants desperately to grant them but doesn't understand that most wishes are impossible.
data.monster.hopebringer.desc: A majestic spirit that has learned to grant wishes in ways that actually help. It understands now that the best wishes are the ones people must work for.
data.monster.memoryveil.desc: A spirit made of preserved memories. It can show you moments from your past with perfect clarity, though it cannot understand why some memories make people cry.
data.monster.dreamspark.desc: A creature that lives in the moment between waking and sleeping. It collects the dreams you forget and sometimes returns them to the wrong people.
data.monster.soulflare.desc: A brilliant spirit that appears during moments of great inspiration. Artists and inventors often see it in the corner of their vision right before a breakthrough.
data.monster.eternawing.desc: A spirit that has witnessed every meaningful moment in history. It carries the weight of time gracefully and believes every small kindness matters.
data.monster.murkmaw.desc: Born from thoughts pushed to the back of minds. It feeds not on fear but on the things people refuse to remember.
data.monster.voidweep.desc: A collector of final moments. It arrives not to cause endings but to witness them, carrying the weight of every 'last time' ever experienced.
data.monster.nullgrave.desc: The shape of what happens when even darkness forgets itself. It is neither evil nor good - it is simply the absence of ever having been.
data.monster.gloomling.desc: A creature that lives in the shadow you cast when no light is present. It's always been there. You just never had reason to look.
data.monster.nightcrawl.desc: A creature that moves only when you're not looking. It's not malicious - it's just incredibly shy and mortified when caught in motion.
data.monster.duskstalker.desc: A graceful predator that has embraced its nature. It no longer feels shame about moving unseen - it has learned that some things must happen in darkness.
data.monster.fearling.desc: A creature made of childhood fears that were never outgrown. It doesn't want to scare anyone - it just doesn't know how to be anything else.
data.monster.umbralynx.desc: A cat made entirely of shadows. It can slip through any space where light doesn't reach and sometimes gets stuck in places that have no shadows.
data.monster.secretkeeper.desc: A creature that feeds on secrets. It knows everything that's ever been whispered in darkness and guards this knowledge jealously, though it has no use for it.
data.monster.eclipsara.desc: A creature that only fully exists during eclipses. Between eclipses, it's only partially real, which it finds deeply inconvenient.
data.monster.nightmarex.desc: The king of bad dreams. It doesn't create nightmares - it rules them, trying to keep them from becoming too frightening because even shadows need balance.
data.monster.primbloom.desc: The first flower that ever opened, still blooming, still closing, caught in the eternal moment of becoming. All plants remember being part of it.
data.monster.sunforged.desc: A creature made from a fragment of the sun that fell to earth. It radiates warmth that can melt stone and light that casts no shadows.
data.monster.absolutezero.desc: The theoretical coldest possible creature. It exists at temperatures where even atoms stop moving. Time itself seems to slow in its presence.
data.monster.stormtyrant.desc: The spirit of the most powerful storm that ever raged. It doesn't create storms - storms remember what it felt like to be part of this one and try to recreate it.
data.monster.mythweaver.desc: The creature that exists because stories needed to be told. It is not the first beast, but the reason beasts exist in stories at all. All creatures are echoes of its dreaming.
data.monster.worldserpent.desc: A creature so vast that its body encircles the world. What we see is only the smallest part of it - the rest exists in dimensions we cannot perceive.
data.monster.voiddragon.desc: A dragon that exists in the space between stars. It eats light and exhales darkness. Where it flies, the universe forgets that stars were ever there.
data.monster.genesis.desc: A primordial egg of obsidian, cracked with veins of golden light. Within, something vast stirs - wings of pure creation folding and unfolding. It is the moment before birth, frozen in time. All that ever was or will be sleeps inside.
data.monster.genisoul.desc: The very first consciousness to emerge from the void. It remembers a time before time, when existence was merely a suggestion waiting to be spoken.
data.monster.primeflare.desc: A flame born from the death of something greater. The ground cracks and crumbles beneath it, unable to contain a fire that was never meant to exist.
data.monster.voidbloom.desc: A flower that took root on the threshold between life and death. One half blooms in dark violet; the other crumbles into void. It has never fully belonged to either world.
data.monster.edenseed.desc: The seed from which the Garden of Origins itself grew. It carries within it the blueprint for all life that ever was or will be.
data.monster.aquagenesis.desc: The primordial droplet from which all waters flowed. Oceans, rivers, rain, and tears - all remember being part of this single drop.
data.monster.prismite.desc: A small weasel-like creature inspired by the Raiju of Japanese legend. Its sleek dark teal fur is marked with faint glowing yellow stripes, and a spark crackles at the tip of its long tail when startled.
data.monster.terracub.desc: A chubby bear cub made of living stone and packed earth. It loves to dig and tumble, leaving small craters wherever it plays.
data.monster.dandepuff.desc: A tiny creature shaped like a dandelion puff, born from the first breath ever exhaled. Its fluffy seeds drift away and become new breezes.
data.monster.raijura.desc: The full Raiju realized - a powerful serpentine thunder weasel wreathed in crackling lightning. Its dark teal body is covered in blazing yellow storm markings, and its long whip-like tail trails bolts of electricity. It moves like living lightning, striking before its thunder arrives.
data.monster.arcferron.desc: As Prismite grows, its sleek body elongates and its teal fur darkens. Bright yellow lightning patterns streak across its back and arcs of electricity snap between its pointed ears. Faster than the eye can follow, it leaves afterimages of crackling light.
data.monster.devorah.desc: A squat, heavily-armored reptile inspired by Ammit, the Egyptian devourer of unworthy souls. Its broad crocodilian jaw unhinges impossibly wide, revealing a faint golden glow deep within its maw - the last light of every heart it has judged. Dark bronze scales shift to shadow at the edges, and its eyes burn with ancient authority.
data.monster.pucling.desc: A swift hare-like creature inspired by the Puca of Celtic legend. Its pale fur flickers between solid and translucent as it darts through the wind, leaving shimmering afterimages in its wake. Its long ears twist toward sounds that haven't happened yet.
data.monster.scaldnip.desc: A small crab-like creature inspired by the Cherufe of Mapuche legend. Its rocky shell glows with veins of molten magma, and its claws snap with bursts of sparks. It skitters along volcanic vents where dimensions grind together, feeding on the heat of colliding realities.
data.monster.primordius.desc: The first matter that ever existed, before it chose what to become. It holds within it the potential to be anything - stone, star, or soul.
data.monster.nihilex.desc: A formless shadow coiled around a dying star. Inspired by Erebus, the primordial darkness that existed before light, its body is a swirling vortex of deep violet and black with a single pale eye at its center that sees into the space between moments.
data.monster.songborne.desc: The first voice that ever spoke, still singing. Reality ripples outward from its song - every sound ever heard is an echo of its endless melody.
data.monster.fungrowth.desc: A towering mushroom that walks on root-like legs. Spores drift from its cap like snow, and wherever they land, new fungi spring up overnight.
data.monster.hinobi.desc: A small monkey wrapped in smoldering bandages, darting through shadows with embers trailing behind. It watches from rooftops and vanishes before anyone can look twice.
data.monster.enkong.desc: A fearsome monkey warrior with golden eyes that see through smoke and shadow. Its tail burns like a whip of living flame, said to have once set an entire fortress ablaze in a single sweep.
data.monster.namashira.desc: A colossal catfish from deep beneath the ocean floor, inspired by the Namazu of Japanese legend. Glowing fault lines crack across its ancient hide, and its long whiskers trail like seismic waves. When it stirs, coastlines reshape and tides reverse.
data.monster.chalkodon.desc: A towering automaton forged from living metal, inspired by the bronze guardian Talos of Greek legend. Molten ichor flows through a single vein from head to ankle, and its hollow body rings like a war bell with every step.
data.monster.fujinara.desc: A wild spirit that carries the world's winds in a great swirling sack upon its back, inspired by Fujin of Japanese legend. When it opens the sack, storms are born. When it laughs, hurricanes follow.
data.monster.bluffrost.desc: A bumbling ice spirit inspired by the storms of the Yuki-onna legend. It wraps itself in snowfall like a cloak and tries to look menacing, but its round body and stubby arms make it look like an angry snowdrift. It huffs icy breath to seem fearsome, then sneezes and freezes itself solid.
